claims.text: The driver's own trace never places him inside the pickup geofence. Across 86 fixes his closest approach to the pickup pin is 647.3 m, and the number of qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class is zero (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0). POL-NS-02 therefore finds the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause.

The driver's 07:38:35 'I'm Here' tap is a false arrival marker. At that timestamp his trace places him at least 647 m from the pickup pin, far past the 300 m trigger in POL-NS-05, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip. Under POL-NS-05(ii) the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded in the referrals as a false-arrival event against the driver.

The arrival event on this record is the driver's own button press, not a platform measurement: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and the events list reads 'Driver tapped I'm Here'. POL-NS-12's deference to platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival is therefore unavailable, and the arrival event cannot stand in for the exported trace, which shows no arrival at all.

Effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period in force for this trip, 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The only route by which the driver could lengthen the clock - accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) - is closed on this record. The trace shows zero in-geofence runs (run_count 0, longest_run_sec 0.0), so there is nothing to sum, and no advisory covers this pickup road at all: I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02709-01 is MISSING, status MISSING, weight 0.0, and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) cannot operate here.

POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the fee. The wrong-entrance clause reaches only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin; this driver's trace never comes closer than 647.3 m, so the 400 m ceiling is not met, no wrong-entrance finding is available, and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable.

The rider was at the pickup throughout. The rider track carries 60 qualifying fixes with a mean distance of 10.4 m and a maximum of 13.8 m from the pin, all at 0.0 km/h - comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius set by POL-NS-04. That answers the driver's statement that 'the rider did not come'; I cite limb (c)'s presence test alone, and do not claim POL-NS-04 exoneration, because the driver's 07:39:45 reply came within 120 seconds of the rider's message and limb (b) is not met.

The driver told the rider at 07:39:45 'im here already' while his own trace places him at least 647 m from the pickup pin at every fix of the trip. The only admissible record of his position contradicts the assurance he gave the rider and corroborates the rider's account that the car was never at the pickup.

The contested sum is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, charged at 07:43:54 and still standing (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.50). On a rider-filed dispute the disposition is FULL_REFUND of that line - the whole contested amount returned to the filing party - and no booking, platform or waiting-time charge arises on a trip that never started.

claims.text: The trip record satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d): it carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:35 and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:43:37 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises — with no boarding event recorded anywhere in the trip. Two of the four limbs are carried on the face of the record.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is closed at limb (b). The rider's 07:39:15 message 'where are you? i dont see any car' was answered by the driver at 07:39:45 — 30 seconds later, well inside the 120 second window — and the reply was delivered and read at 07:40:05. Because the driver did reply within 120 seconds, POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider on any reading, and the residual mislocation question falls back to POL-NS-01.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the count of 4 the clause requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 103 is 0.0097, well under the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so there is no compensation-withholding finding and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation, and no pattern of no-show fee harvesting stands behind this cancellation.

There was no early abandonment by the driver. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), the platform's wait timer started at 07:38:37, and the driver did not cancel until 07:43:37 — 302 seconds later — while still replying to the rider in chat at 07:39:45. I accept that limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, so this point goes to the character of the cancellation rather than to the dwell arithmetic.

I concede the position element on the driver's own evidence, as I must. derived.arrival reports qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds, and derived.driver_track reports a closest approach of 647.3 m to the pickup pin across all 86 fixes, so no fix places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-02's proximity test is therefore not met and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails on the driver's side, so the $4.50 cancellation fee recorded on the fare breakdown cannot stand; the driver's good-faith wait and clean anti-farming record go to how the false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) is characterised, not to whether the charge survives.

ruling.explanation:
Ruling for the rider, and the reasoning in plain language for both of you. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded to the rider in full; no driver compensation is payable; the fee was collected as a rider-filed charge and is returned. The amount is read from the money block: fare_breakdown.total_charged 4.50 and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 4.50 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically.

The fee cannot stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and limb (b) fails. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02709 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, 86 fixes, no gap over 120 s) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class: his closest approach across the whole trip is 647.3 m and the count of qualifying in-radius fixes is 0. On that evidence POL-NS-02 finds the driver never arrived, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not met. The driver's own advocate concedes exactly this on the same numbers, so it is common ground.

The 'I'm Here' event at 07:38:35 is a false arrival marker. The record shows the marker was the driver's own button press (platform_policy.arrival_marker BUTTON), and at that timestamp the trace placed him more than 300 m from the pin — indeed never closer than 647.3 m at any fix. Under POL-NS-05 the marker does not start the waiting clock; the clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and because no such fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund of the cancellation fee, no driver compensation, and the false-arrival record set out in the referrals. Independently, POL-NS-06 gives the same result: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s.

The driver's surviving points, and why they do not change the outcome. Limbs (a) and (d) are indeed met — there is an 'arrived' event at 07:38:35, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:43:37 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event — but limbs (a) and (d) alone do not carry the fee; limb (b) is measured from the trace and fails. The 302 seconds between the arrival tap (07:38:37 wait-timer start) and the 07:43:37 cancellation is real time, but limb (c) and POL-NS-05 both measure the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and there is no such fix; so the long wait does not save the charge. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider from the fee's point of view — the driver replied at 07:39:45, 30 seconds after the rider's 07:39:15 message, inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) is not met — but the rider does not need POL-NS-04, because the refund comes from POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. POL-NS-12 does not apply: it covers only platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, and this record's marker is a driver button press. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver never came within 400 m of the pin, so no wrong-entrance finding and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arise. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 103 (rate 0.0097), below both limbs — so no compensation is withheld on that ground, and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation follows.

The rider's surviving points are accepted as corroboration. The rider track carries 60 qualifying fixes at a mean 10.4 m and maximum 13.8 m from the pin, all stationary, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius; this supports the rider's account and answers the driver's statement that the rider did not come, though the refund does not depend on it. The rider's observation that the driver wrote 'im here already' at 07:39:45 while the only admissible position record puts him at least 647.3 m away is accepted: the chat is consistent with the rider's version of events.

One rider claim was removed by the referee and is not relied on: the argument that POL-NS-06(i) is closed by the absent traffic advisory was discarded because it cited the MISSING artifact EV-ADVIS-02709-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) without naming the issue code. Nothing turns on it; the advisory is absent, so no accumulation of intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available in any event, and the refund rests on the shortfall itself.

Confidence is 0.95. The deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-02709 at weight 1.0, and no artifact below 1.0 carries it; the missing advisory is not the evidence for any deciding fact, and the trace is complete with no gaps, so POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-05 resolves rather than leaves the arrival conflict, the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no_show_disputes_30d is 1. The case is therefore decided, not escalated.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties' accounts and the driver's own evidence converge: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand and is returned in full to the rider.

The fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if all four limbs hold. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02709) carries the driver's 'arrived' tap at 07:38:35 (limb (a)) and the termination by the driver at 07:43:37 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event (limb (d)) — I accept both. Limb (b) fails: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709, weight 1.0) places the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at 647.3 m across all 86 fixes, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and total in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds, 180 seconds short of the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02709, platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-02 therefore finds the driver never arrived.

POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) does not rescue the fee: it reaches only a driver stationary within 400 m of the pin, and 647.3 m exceeds that ceiling, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable. POL-NS-05 makes the 07:38:35 'I'm Here' tap a false arrival marker — at that timestamp the driver was 647 m away, past the 300 m trigger — and because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation; the same result follows from POL-NS-06 on the 0-second dwell against the 180-second minimum.

On the driver's side, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below 4; 1 ÷ 103 completed trips = 0.0097, below 0.08), so no withholding finding and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation — but compensation is not payable in any event, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied. The driver's reply at 07:39:45, 30 seconds after the rider's 07:39:15 'where are you? i dont see any car', closes POL-NS-04 at limb (b), so the rider is not exonerated under that clause; it makes no difference, because the fee fails on the arrival test. The rider's track (60 qualifying fixes, mean 10.4 m from the pin, max 13.8 m) confirms the rider was at the pickup, contrary to the driver's statement that the rider did not come.

The trip record's arrival event and the GPS trace contradict each other on arrival, but POL-NS-05 resolves that conflict (the marker is false and the clock recomputes to zero), so POL-NS-09(b) escalation is not engaged. No artifact deciding the case is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): coverage is 100%, no gap exceeds 120 s, the chat sequence is intact, and the fare line reconciles to the resolution-rule figure. The rider's claim that the missing advisory could not support POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was discarded at the mechanical stage because it cited EV-ADVIS-02709-01 without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code; in any event nothing turns on it, since the trace shows zero in-geofence intervals to sum.

The amount is read from EV-FARE-02709: total_charged 4.50, cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The full 4.50 is refunded. The monetary effect is below the 8.00 execution threshold.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties agree on the decisive point, and the record confirms it. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02709) is complete — 100% coverage, no gaps, 86 fixes at 10-second intervals — and across every fix the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 was 647.3 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), with zero qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0). POL-NS-02 therefore finds the driver never arrived: POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and limb (c) fails with it — the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 180-second shortfall that independently mandates the same result under POL-NS-06. Because POL-NS-02's wrong-entrance carve-out does not reach this case (the 400 m ceiling of POL-NS-03 is not met at 647.3 m), POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The 07:38:35 'I'm Here' marker was a false arrival: at that timestamp the trace places the driver roughly 647 m away, far past POL-NS-05's 300 m trigger, and since no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere on the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full, pays no driver compensation, and records a false-arrival referral.

The rider is refunded the full contested sum of SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02709: total_charged 4.50, cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to hold in full, and limbs (b) and (c) do not, so the 80% figure of SGD 3.60 is not reached. No waiting-time or booking charge arises on a trip that never started.

On the driver's points, I accept that POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are recorded — a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:35 and a driver termination at 07:43:37 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event — and that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because the driver replied in chat 30 seconds after the rider's 07:39:15 message, inside limb (b)'s 120-second window. I also accept that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1, below the required 4; 1/103 = 0.0097, below 0.08), so no withholding or POL-NS-09(d) escalation arises. None of this changes the outcome: the fee depends on arrival and dwell, and the driver's own trace fails both. The rider's POL-NS-04 limb (c) point (60 rider fixes, mean 10.4 m from the pin) is noted but not needed, as the rider expressly does not claim exoneration under that clause. POL-NS-12 is unavailable because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the driver's tap cannot stand in for the trace. The 07:39:45 chat message 'im here already' is contradicted by the trace, but the GPS position, not the message, is decisive.

Confidence is 0.9. The deciding fact is carried by EV-GPS-02709 and EV-TRIP-02709, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; every other artifact is also at 1.0, and EV-ADVIS-02709-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries nothing, no clause having relied on it (POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable for that reason). No artifact meets POL-NS-08(a)–(d), so nothing is impaired at policy level and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): false-arrival record against driver DRV-09709 — the 'I'm Here' marker was tapped at 07:38:35 while the driver's own GPS trace placed him at least 647 m from the pickup pin, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace never places him inside the pickup geofence. Across 86 fixes his closest approach to the pickup pin is 647.3 m, and the number of qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class is zero (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0). POL-NS-02 therefore finds the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause.

The driver's 07:38:35 'I'm Here' tap is a false arrival marker. At that timestamp his trace places him at least 647 m from the pickup pin, far past the 300 m trigger in POL-NS-05, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip. Under POL-NS-05(ii) the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded in the referrals as a false-arrival event against the driver.

The arrival event on this record is the driver's own button press, not a platform measurement: trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and the events list reads 'Driver tapped I'm Here'. POL-NS-12's deference to platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival is therefore unavailable, and the arrival event cannot stand in for the exported trace, which shows no arrival at all.

Effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period in force for this trip, 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The only route by which the driver could lengthen the clock - accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) - is closed on this record. The trace shows zero in-geofence runs (run_count 0, longest_run_sec 0.0), so there is nothing to sum, and no advisory covers this pickup road at all: I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02709-01 is MISSING, status MISSING, weight 0.0, and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) cannot operate here.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02709-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ledger.claim: POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the fee. The wrong-entrance clause reaches only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin; this driver's trace never comes closer than 647.3 m, so the 400 m ceiling is not met, no wrong-entrance finding is available, and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable.

The rider was at the pickup throughout. The rider track carries 60 qualifying fixes with a mean distance of 10.4 m and a maximum of 13.8 m from the pin, all at 0.0 km/h - comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius set by POL-NS-04. That answers the driver's statement that 'the rider did not come'; I cite limb (c)'s presence test alone, and do not claim POL-NS-04 exoneration, because the driver's 07:39:45 reply came within 120 seconds of the rider's message and limb (b) is not met.

The driver told the rider at 07:39:45 'im here already' while his own trace places him at least 647 m from the pickup pin at every fix of the trip. The only admissible record of his position contradicts the assurance he gave the rider and corroborates the rider's account that the car was never at the pickup.

The contested sum is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, charged at 07:43:54 and still standing (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.50). On a rider-filed dispute the disposition is FULL_REFUND of that line - the whole contested amount returned to the filing party - and no booking, platform or waiting-time charge arises on a trip that never started.

The trip record satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d): it carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:35 and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:43:37 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises — with no boarding event recorded anywhere in the trip. Two of the four limbs are carried on the face of the record.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is closed at limb (b). The rider's 07:39:15 message 'where are you? i dont see any car' was answered by the driver at 07:39:45 — 30 seconds later, well inside the 120 second window — and the reply was delivered and read at 07:40:05. Because the driver did reply within 120 seconds, POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider on any reading, and the residual mislocation question falls back to POL-NS-01.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the count of 4 the clause requires, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 103 is 0.0097, well under the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so there is no compensation-withholding finding and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation, and no pattern of no-show fee harvesting stands behind this cancellation.

There was no early abandonment by the driver. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), the platform's wait timer started at 07:38:37, and the driver did not cancel until 07:43:37 — 302 seconds later — while still replying to the rider in chat at 07:39:45. I accept that limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, so this point goes to the character of the cancellation rather than to the dwell arithmetic.

I concede the position element on the driver's own evidence, as I must. derived.arrival reports qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds, and derived.driver_track reports a closest approach of 647.3 m to the pickup pin across all 86 fixes, so no fix places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. POL-NS-02's proximity test is therefore not met and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails on the driver's side, so the $4.50 cancellation fee recorded on the fare breakdown cannot stand; the driver's good-faith wait and clean anti-farming record go to how the false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) is characterised, not to whether the charge survives.
